entries.name: Lucky Starfall
entries.detail: Due to recent instability in the Dota 2 Arcade servers, ranked-mode point gains can now critically strike (×1.25) or super-critically strike (×1.5). Point losses remain unaffected.

entries.name: IO recruitment
entries.detail: Fixed a bug where IO could not be recruited after selecting Serendipity Compass

entries.name: Serendipity Compass
entries.detail: Conditions for -2/-1 recruit cost changed to (0-2 / 3-8 of this unit already recruited) (old: 0 / 1-4)

entries.name: Ancient Apparition - Chilling Touch
entries.detail: Duration increased from 4/6/10s to 6/8/12s; attack-speed slow adjusted from 30/40/60% to 40/50/60%

entries.name: Witch Doctor - Paralyzing Cask
entries.detail: Cooldown reduced from 10/9/8s to 10/8/6s; bounce count increased from 4/5/6 to 4/5/7

entries.name: Mech - Heart of Machine
entries.detail: (6) Mechs gold-upgrade chance at courier level 6/7/8/9/10 changed from 25%/50%/75%/100%/100% to 20%/40%/60%/80%/100%

entries.name: Aqir - Infection
entries.detail: Spawn delay for Aqir units reduced from 0.5s to 0.1s
